title: ImageEval 2026: Culturally Grounded Arabic Multimodal Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of approaches, including zero-shot prompting, fine-tuning of vision-language models, speech-recognition pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration. We describe the task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and participating systems, and summarize the main results across the different tracks. translated_title: ImageEval 2026：文化扎根的阿拉伯语多模态评测
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了 ImageEval 2026 共享任务的概述，该任务聚焦于文化扎根的阿拉伯语多模态评测。它包含两个任务：（i）AynVQA，涵盖英语和现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的口语化视觉问答以及基于图像的幻觉检测；（ii）CRAI-Bench，用于评估文本到图像生成的文化准确性。共有 14 支队伍参加了测试阶段，其中 12 支队伍提交了系统描述论文。参赛系统采用了多种方法，包括零样本提示、视觉-语言模型微调、语音识别流水线、集成方法以及分数校准。我们描述了任务设置、数据集、评测流程和参赛系统，并总结了各赛道的主要结果。该共享任务的所有数据集和评测脚本均已向研究社区发布。该共享任务凸显了文化扎根评测所面临的挑战……
tldr: ImageEval 2026 共享任务通过 AynVQA（口语视觉问答与幻觉检测）和 CRAI-Bench（文生图文化准确性）两项任务系统评估了阿拉伯语文化场景下的多模态模型能力，并向社区公开了全部数据集与评测脚本。
en_tdlr: The ImageEval 2026 shared task benchmarks culturally grounded Arabic multimodal capabilities through AynVQA (spoken VQA and hallucination detection) and CRAI-Bench (cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation), releasing all datasets and evaluation scripts to the research community.
